label: EMULATOR

best_known.rule: non-dominated set (true f) of Sobol 2^14 + 64 vertices + 98 scalarizations + every design evaluated by any lane, single run, random pool or matched-budget baseline; a LOWER bound on the true front

baseline_rule: matched budget: same 48 starts (true f), 8 designs per round x 4, true-f HV / best-known HV per round; uniform = i.i.d. u; vertices = 32 of the 64 box vertices without replacement; plugin_random = 32 random designs of the r0 plug-in front; plugin_spread = 32 designs at quantiles of the plug-in front (1 replicate, no exploration); 1000 replicates, default_rng(20261166)

seed_overlap.statement: Under option C, 17 of the 40 r1 PCM runs would duplicate another lane's design (exact match to 1e-10 in u). Shared replicates vs run all is a decision for Kay.
